scene: The trapdoor reveals a transit rooftop overlooking three ready rides.
picture: Flat side view. Along the far left, a docked blue harbour ferry bobs by a pier. To its right, the player in her yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands by an open wooden trapdoor. In the centre, a tiled subway entrance leads down. On the far right, a yellow tram waits.
shown: a blue ferryboat docked at a wooden pier on the far left
a tiled subway stairwell with an open metal turnstile in the centre
a yellow street tram waiting with open doors on the far right

variants.scene: Salty evening air greets you on the bustling pier by three waiting routes.
You climb onto the wooden deck while humming {tune} under the dusky sky.
Tides lap against the pilings as evening commuters gather by land and sea.
